scientific_integrity: Analytical results are derived from an explicitly defined fresh-Gaussian-row stochastic projection model; numerical checks corroborate only finite cases. No independent verification or publication priority is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The noisy coefficient candidates are independently redrawn at each iteration, not frozen for an entire solve.
Gaussian coefficient noise has nondegenerate full-dimensional covariance sigma^2 times identity, and fixed b is nonzero.
The moment theorem says nothing about approximation to a prescribed deterministic solution.
Centered-Gaussian exact constants do not extend unchanged to nonzero coefficient means.
title: Sharp moment thresholds for Gaussian-noisy, norm-weighted Kaczmarz projections
